_notes: WHERE A CHANGE HAS TO REACH.
Every component in this game is assembled from pieces in different files.
A minigame is a rules class AND a screen AND a data file AND a bot AND a
launch spec. Adding one and forgetting another does not fail loudly -- it
fails as a dead button, a quest nobody photographed, a portrait that
renders as a black rectangle. Those are the defects that reached owner
reviews, over and over, and they are all propagation failures.
This file is the answer to 'I changed X -- what else has to move?'. It is
machine-readable so `python tools/kb_check.py` can prove the paths still
exist and, for several of these chains, that the propagation actually
happened. The prose companion is docs/architecture/README.md.
HOW TO USE IT: find your change below, walk `touch` in order, then run
everything in `verify`. Steps marked "auto": true need no action -- some
other file already derives from the one you edited, and that is worth
knowing so you do not go looking for a list to update.
HOW TO MAINTAIN IT: when you add a component kind, add its chain here in
the same edit. kb_check fails on a path that stops existing, which is what
keeps this file from rotting into fiction.
The engine boundary, stated once. A change that crosses a layer is the
kind most likely to need propagation.
layers.game/core/: Pure rules. RefCounted only -- no Node, no rendering, no FileAccess, no global RNG. All randomness through CoreRng, all player actions through do_command(). Load-bearing for deterministic tests, the balance sims and replay debugging.
layers.game/services/: The only layer that touches the filesystem: DataLoader (content in), SaveService (profile out), Strings (interface prose).
layers.game/scenes/: UI. Screens subscribe to core state and never mutate it directly. game.gd is the flow orchestrator and the only file that decides what comes next.
layers.game/ui/: Shared widgets and the layout contract (UITheme).
layers.game/data/: Content and tuning as JSON, keyed by stable string ids.
layers.game/story/: Prose. Scene scripts, and the game's own voice outside a scripted scene.
layers.game/tests/: Unit tests plus the harnesses: tour, page guard, balance sim, chaos fuzzer, minigame bots, bestiary generator.
